senses.gloss: f. (v. זַיִף, a. אַרְדַּפְנֵי = הַרְדַּ׳; cmp. Löw, Pfl. p. 320) hypericum (barbatum), St. John’s wort, a plant said to be fatal to cattle.
units: B. Kam. 47ᵇ באר׳ Ar. a. Ms. H. (Var. הרזיפא, v. Koh. Ar.; ed. אפר׳) under ‘poison’ is meant arzafta which may also be called peré (fruit, produces of the earth).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 20a:3">B. Bath. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>אר׳</he> Ar. (Ms. <cite ref="A03173"><he>אר׳</he></cite>, changed into <cite ref="A01567"><he>אפ׳</he></cite> as ed.). Cmp. <cite ref="E00849"><he>הַרְזִיפּוּ</he></cite>.
